lanes.anchor_source: Novy-Marx 2013 JFE quality-factor IC range 0.30-0.50 for cross-sectional fundamental momentum strategies

lanes.anchor_source: Novy-Marx 2013 JFE realized cross-sectional factor-momentum pro-Sharpe ceiling 3-5 (out-of-sample, cap 5.0 as documented realistic upper bound)

lanes.description: Awards 5 pts when submitted self_reported_metrics agree with judge-recomputed metrics within tolerance; 0 on divergence (cross-lane veto NOT applied — L7 is standalone here per PKW-FAMILIES §3 Framework B minimum-viable variant).

Awards up to 10 pts based on mean per-quarter normalized performance across L1/L2/L3/L4/L5/L6, discounted by variance across the 5 test quarters. Copy-last-quarter is stable but low-mean; genuine momentum capture has moderate variance and higher mean.

Bonus lane (+10, additive over 100). Awards up to 10 pts for detection precision of filers whose OperatingIncomeLoss/Revenues bottomed in CY2024Q4-CY2025Q2 and recovered CY2025Q3-CY2026Q1 (post-2022-hike margin-compression-to-recovery regime shift).
